scope: Corollary 6.6 (Stationary endpoint predictors) of the manuscript “Cutoff throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase” (preprints/Cutoff-throughout-the-high-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-phase-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d99d391c8c3ed79f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 63. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let ai be a nonnegative row label on a span of length d, bounded above by a masked likelihood ℓM i ; factors vi ≤ 1 and cutoff indicators are allowed. Its stationary predictor at the right endpoint has every fixed positive spatial moment bounded by eo(d). The same bound holds after conditioning at a later endpoint. Its predictor at the left endpoint is bounded by one. Raw fixed-order moments cost at most eCpd.
